subject: Gentle reminder regarding the shelving brackets
text: I wanted to follow up on the shelving brackets we discussed last Tuesday. I realize you have been occupied with your own repairs, so please don’t feel hurried. When you have a free moment, could you let me know whether you were still able to bring them over this week? If the timing is awkward, I completely understand, and I can arrange to pick them up at the porch instead. I only ask because the remaining shelf pieces need to be secured before the storage area is cleared on Saturday. There is no need for you to rush or adjust your evening routine. A short note whenever convenient would be enough, even if the answer is that the task will need another day or two. A quick reply is all I need. Thank you for your patience and for helping with something I have been postponing for longer than I should have.
